document.about: Lutron Maestro specification submittal 369613a. Its wiring page heads each diagram with a bold title: the first diagram stands bare, the 3-way diagrams in boxes, each title between the diagram above and the box it heads.

notes: #279: the title of the second diagram, set under the first, was taken as the first's label, while its twin over the third read as a heading. A title between two drawings heads the lower; over a framed drawing, a title that is no caption is the page's.

checks.issue: #279: `3-Way Wiring (Using 3-Way Mechanical Switch)` was the first diagram's label, under it.
A guard: its twin over the third diagram stays a heading.
